Both accept and decline test orders show identical receipt_line_items (base 2x bundle only). Accept path clicked through upsell-1 and the upsell-add API succeeded, but the QA toolkit's captured receipt_line_items doesn't include the upsell tier. Either re-read order lines after upsell-add, or rename the field. New friction for SELL-271.

Re-running campaigns-os start to regenerate the packet (e.g., to flip --test-orders-allowed on) wiped the populated .campaign-runtime/assembly-report.json and build-context.json. Lifecycle state was rebuilt from scratch and had to be manually restored from git. Either expose qa policy set as a non-destructive subcommand, or have start detect existing report content and merge instead of overwrite. New friction for SELL-271.

Live page has a 404 on /home-outage-prep-v0/images/credit-card-flags.svg (demeter starter asset reference). Demeter starter ships partials that reference an asset not in the template's own assets/images/. Polish item.

Raw browser event logs also include [ApiClient] API request failed: signal is aborted without reason during navigation. It did not drive the top-level QA warning in this run, but remains useful SDK noise to quiet separately.
